name: capacity-guard
description: Prompt-first quota checks and recoverable safe stopping for explicitly guarded work.

interface.shortDescription: Stop long tasks at a chosen remaining-quota threshold.
interface.longDescription: Uses the agreed remaining-quota threshold to stop adding work, close in-progress operations safely, and save a checkpoint. Best-effort prompt guidance; no tool-blocking hooks.
defaultPrompt: Use $capacity-guard to run this task until the remaining quota reaches my chosen threshold.
